name: Windtotem the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Windtotem the Elder receives travelers on a bluff above Ratchet. She welcomes those who honor the wisdom of ages past and offers an ancestral blessing and guidance to other elders across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Vigil Over the Bay
sections.body: On a grassy hill just northwest of Ratchet’s flight master, Windtotem the Elder watches over the goblin docks and open sea. Iron, gunpowder, and coin pass through the harbor below, while quiet Barrens winds and a shaft of celestial light reach the elder.

sections.title: Wisdom Across the Barrens
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, Windtotem the Elder guides wandering mortals, as do the other ancestral spirits. Those who seek her receive her blessing and a token of her favor, along with whispers pointing to nearby elders across the continent, including Elder Runetotem and Elder Bloodhoof.

faq.answer: Windtotem the Elder stands on a hill just northwest of Ratchet’s flight master, overlooking the harbor in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Windtotem?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers seek Windtotem the Elder to honor an ancestor. She grants you a Coin of Ancestry and tells you where to find other spirits across the land.

faq.q: Why is there a beam of light shining down on her?
faq.answer: The Lunar Festival’s manifested ancestors each stand in a distinct pillar of celestial moonlight, marking their presence between the ancestral realm and the living world.

faq.q: Can Alliance and Horde players both speak to Elder Windtotem?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is a neutral port administered by the Steamwheedle Cartel, and the Lunar Festival elders welcome both Alliance and Horde members.

faq.q: Which other elders does Elder Windtotem tell you about?
faq.answer: Windtotem the Elder gives guidance about nearby ancestors, including Elder Bloodhoof, Elder Runetotem, Elder Morningdew, Elder Darkhorn, Elder High Mountain, Elder Moonwarden, and Elder Proudhorn.

faq.q: What happens when you complete homage to the elder?
faq.answer: When you approach and honor Windtotem the Elder, she praises your spirit for burning brightly with life, accepts your respect, and gives you a Coin of Ancestry.

angles.text: As a tauren, you honor an ancestor of the ancient Windtotem lineage above the goblin harbor, connecting you to the ancestral memory of the plains.
As a druid, you share in the Lunar Festival’s celebration of communion with the natural and celestial cycles guarded by the Cenarion Circle.
As a shaman, you honor the dead and tend the land’s spiritual health when you speak with ancestor spirits near elemental crossings.
